name: offline-state
title: Offline state
description: The page-sized 'you are offline' state: what still works on the device, a Try again button, and a Back online moment with an automatic retry.
docs: It follows the browser's online and offline events, or your own online prop, and it is hidden whenever the browser knows it is online, including the first paint. Offline it shows a wifi-off icon, 'You are offline', what is safe on the device, an optional last-saved line from cachedAt (written in locale and timeZone), your children under 'Still works offline', and a Try again button that calls onRetry, shows a spinner and says 'Still offline' if it did not help, on a line that has its room from the start so the button never moves. When the connection returns it says 'Back online' for a moment, calls onRetry once and steps aside. The change is announced through a polite status region and focus never moves. It is page-sized: cover your page with className='fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-background' or place it in the content area. The title is a heading at headingLevel (2 by default, 1 when the state is the whole page). labels carries every word.
